title: Three Ways To Draw The Same Guy

shots.line: Three ways to draw the same guy.
shots.scene: Line-up: three figures side by side on the ground line, breathing, labelled STICKMAN / THE BEAN / THE INKLING.

shots.line: Same story, same gesture, different skin.
shots.scene: All three perform the identical point gesture landed on the word 'gesture', brow rising with it. (edited)

shots.line: Which one do you trust for fifty episodes?
shots.scene: Three faces blown up large, expression turning surprised on 'fifty' — the face-treatment comparison.
